meta.name: improve-codebase-architecture
meta.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码库发现架构改进点，生成可视化报告并逐项审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望系统化发现并改进代码库的架构问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to systematically find and fix architecture issues in your codebase

howto.what: 扫描代码库，识别浅层模块并生成加深机会的HTML报告，然后引导你选择其中一个进行详细探讨。
howto.when: 当你请求改善代码库架构，或指定某个模块、子系统时触发。

say.text: 分析当前项目的架构，找出可以加深的模块。
say.note: Claude会生成一份HTML报告，列出候选方案。

say.text: 帮我扫描代码库热点区域，提出重构建议。
say.note: Claude会基于提交历史确定热点。

say.text: 选择第一个候选方案，我们深入讨论。
say.note: Claude会运行grilling技能，一步步拆解决策。

howto.what_en: Scan the codebase, identify shallow modules and generate an HTML report of deepening opportunities, then guide you to pick one for detailed discussion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to improve the codebase architecture, or specify a module or subsystem.

say_en.text: Analyze the project's architecture and find modules that can be deepened.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an HTML report with candidates.

say_en.text: Scan the codebase hot spots and suggest refactoring ideas.
say_en.note: Claude determines hot spots from commit history.

say_en.text: Pick the first candidate, let's drill into it.
say_en.note: Claude runs the grilling skill to walk through decisions.
